newsitem.title: USA: Elcor to name H. Work as president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Elcor to name H. Work as president/CEO.

text.p: Elcor Corp said Tuesday that Harold Work and Richard Rosebery had been elected vice chairmen, and the board plans to elect Work as president and chief executive following the annual meeting on October 28.
The steps are as part of a management succession plan set at an August 18 board meeting, it said.
As president and CEO, Work will succeed Roy Campbell, who will remain chairman.
Work will continue as vice chairman and president, CEO and director of Elk Corp of Dallas and its subsidiaries, which constitute Elcor's core roofing products business.
Work was elected vice president of Elcor in 1982. Rosebery was elected vice president in 1975.
